apply_color_transfer: apply color transfer from target to source image using LAB color space for face swapping
create_face_mask: create a face mask from 106-point facial landmarks with padded convex hull and blurred edges
create_lower_mouth_mask: create a lower mouth mask from landmark 52-71 with configurable expansion and chin bias
create_eyes_mask: create an eyes mask using elliptical regions around landmark-based eye centers
create_eyebrows_mask: create eyebrows mask with curved quadratic Bézier shapes and multi-stage feathering
